About idle()

Quiet lo-fi for the moment your work pauses.

idle() is the music of ipe() — calm lo-fi, ambient and healing tracks for tired developers and late-night focus. This site, idle.ipe.rest, is where the music lives: you can browse the albums and singles, read the journal, and open every track on YouTube in English or Korean.

Who runs this site

idle.ipe.rest is operated by Davy Kim (ipe Studio), an individual developer. ipe() is short for “idle process” — the state a computer enters when it has no work to do and simply rests. It is a small, independent studio making quiet, developer-minded things, and idle() is its music.

You can reach the operator at ipe.haven@gmail.com (see Contact).

How the music is made

We do not hide how the music is made. The music is produced with AI (Suno). Lyrics are AI-drafted and reviewed by a person. Since the dear(you); album, every track closes with a quiet spoken signature — “ipe. be still”.

Our first album, dear(you); vol.1, is ten letters to the you who made it through another hard day. Two singles, “good morning, world” and “still compiling”, sit beside it.

What you will find here

  • The album and singles, with a small player that opens each track on YouTube (English or Korean version).
  • A journal with notes from behind the music.
  • Links to our channels: YouTube, Instagram, SoundCloud.

Free to listen, supported by ads

Everything on this site is free to listen to. To help cover running costs, the site may show advertising, always labelled “Advertisement” and kept apart from the content. How ads and analytics work is explained in the Privacy Policy.

Corrections and feedback

If you find a mistake, a broken link, or something that does not feel right, please write to ipe.haven@gmail.com. We read every message.
